prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 fashion lookbook photo for a Telegram channel. Photorealistic, editorial e-commerce style.

The person is wearing EXACTLY these five items, all clearly visible, nothing else added:
1) a muted khaki-green water-repellent quilted puffer jacket with a zip front, hood and flap patch pockets
2) a regular-fit grey melange long-sleeve sweatshirt in waffle-textured cotton with a ribbed round neckline, cuffs and hem
3) relaxed-fit dark beige cotton cargo pants with straight legs, an elasticated waistband and flap pockets on the legs
4) low-profile white-and-beige faux suede kids' sneakers with a hook-and-loop strap and rubber soles
5) a beige rib-knit wool beanie with a fold-over cuff

Each item must match its description precisely: same colour, material, cut and details. No extra clothing, jewellery or accessories beyond the list. If reference product photos are attached, copy the items from them exactly.

Next to each item place a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) circle with a white number — 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 — matching the list order, with a thin line pointing to the item.

Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#obraz", and next to it a bold near-black headline: "Kuzgi maktab obrazi".
Bottom strip, above a thin divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo", right grey "5 element · $108.95".

Soft even studio lighting, realistic fabric texture, muted palette (khaki green, grey, beige, white). No price tags.
One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
